items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Then there was another band in Milwaukee at that time called Grant Moore and His New Orleans Black Devils and there was another band there called Tommy Fox's band.

ctx.x: No, we had switched now because we had the typical combination for this stuff, the trombone, and we were playing all that kind of stuff at that time. So he took us, and his band took us back to Milwaukee.

Then there was another band in Milwaukee at that time called Grant Moore and His New Orleans Black Devils and there was another band there called Tommy Fox's band. He was a drummer. And there was a band on the Roof Garden, Arthur Simms and his Wisconsin Roof Orchestra which later became Bernie Young's orchestra.
